description: This file defines a client class for interacting with AWS OpenSearch Serverless service via the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes method signatures for various API operations related to OpenSearch Serverless, acting as a wrapper around the base AwsClient.

classes.name: OpenSearchServerlessClient
classes.description: A client class in the AWS SDK for PHP used for interacting with AWS OpenSearch Serverless service.

methods.name: batchGetCollection
methods.description: Retrieves information about collections in OpenSearch Serverless.

methods.name: batchGetCollectionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves information about collections in OpenSearch Serverless.

methods.name: createCollection
methods.description: Creates a new collection in OpenSearch Serverless.

methods.name: createCollectionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new collection in OpenSearch Serverless.

methods.name: deleteCollection
methods.description: Deletes a collection in OpenSearch Serverless.

methods.name: deleteCollectionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a collection in OpenSearch Serverless.

methods.name: getAccountSettings
methods.description: Retrieves account settings for OpenSearch Serverless.

methods.name: getAccountSettingsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves account settings for OpenSearch Serverless.

methods.name: updateCollection
methods.description: Updates a collection in OpenSearch Serverless.

methods.name: updateCollectionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates a collection in OpenSearch Serverless.
